cases.description: GEOGRAPHY ANY/POINT/LINESTRING/POLYGON四列共1000点1000边严格时序试跑
sampleQueries: FETCH PROP ON * "geo_0" YIELD vertex AS v;
FETCH PROP ON geoe "geo_0"->"geo_1"@-500 YIELD edge AS e;
FETCH PROP ON * "geo_500" YIELD vertex AS v;
FETCH PROP ON geoe "geo_500"->"geo_501"@0 YIELD edge AS e;
FETCH PROP ON * "geo_999" YIELD vertex AS v;
FETCH PROP ON geoe "geo_999"->"geo_0"@499 YIELD edge AS e;
